default_authority.principle: Adjournments caused by late Crown disclosure are not defence delay. The Crown's Stinchcombe obligation means that delay attributable to the Crown's failure to provide timely disclosure is Crown/institutional delay.

Defence failure to diligently seek disclosure can convert what would otherwise be Crown delay into defence delay. The defence has an obligation to actively pursue disclosure; passive waiting does not preserve the Crown-delay characterization.

notes: Input model must capture: (a) late Crown disclosure causing adjournment (Crown/institutional attribution); (b) defence failure to diligently seek disclosure (converts to defence delay per Anderson). Both are Tier 3. The Pyrek/Anderson interaction means disclosure delay is fact-specific and cannot be mechanically attributed without user input on diligence.
